content.json:
# Aspire showcase API
Health of the API in the `web` Container App, with its PostgreSQL database and Redis cache, for finding out what is wrong: start on **Overview**, then follow the failing part. Deployed from `src/AspireShowcase.AppHost/workbooks`; changes made in the portal are overwritten on the next deploy.

content.title: In the selected time range

content.query:
requests
| extend status = case(toint(resultCode) >= 500, "5xx", toint(resultCode) >= 400, "4xx", "ok")
| summarize count() by status, bin(timestamp, {TimeRange:grain})
| render timechart
content.title: Requests by status

content.query:
requests
| summarize p50 = percentile(duration, 50), p95 = percentile(duration, 95), p99 = percentile(duration, 99) by bin(timestamp, {TimeRange:grain})
| render timechart
content.title: Latency (ms)

content.query:
requests
| summarize requests = count(), server_errors = countif(toint(resultCode) >= 500), client_errors = countif(toint(resultCode) between (400 .. 499)), avg_ms = round(avg(duration), 1), p95_ms = round(percentile(duration, 95), 1), p99_ms = round(percentile(duration, 99), 1) by name
| order by server_errors desc, p95_ms desc
content.title: Endpoints, worst first

content.query:
let deps = dependencies
| where client_Type != "Browser"
| summarize database_calls = countif(type contains "postgres"), database_ms = sumif(duration, type contains "postgres"), cache_calls = countif(type contains "redis"), cache_ms = sumif(duration, type contains "redis") by operation_Id;
requests
| join kind=leftouter deps on operation_Id
| summarize requests = count(), request_ms = round(avg(duration), 1), database_calls = round(avg(coalesce(database_calls, 0)), 1), database_ms = round(avg(coalesce(database_ms, 0.0)), 1), cache_calls = round(avg(coalesce(cache_calls, 0)), 1), cache_ms = round(avg(coalesce(cache_ms, 0.0)), 1) by name
| order by request_ms desc
content.title: Where the time goes, per endpoint (averages per request)

content.query:
requests
| top 50 by duration desc
| project timestamp, name, resultCode, duration_ms = round(duration, 1), operation_Id
content.title: Slowest requests (copy operation_Id into Trace lookup)

content.query:
requests
| where toint(resultCode) >= 500
| summarize count() by name, bin(timestamp, {TimeRange:grain})
| render timechart
content.title: Server errors (5xx) by endpoint

content.query:
exceptions
| where client_Type != "Browser"
| summarize count() by type, bin(timestamp, {TimeRange:grain})
| render timechart
content.title: Exceptions by type

content.query:
let exc = exceptions
| where client_Type != "Browser"
| summarize arg_min(timestamp, type, outerMessage) by operation_Id
| project operation_Id, exception = type, message = outerMessage;
requests
| where toint(resultCode) >= 500 or success == false
| join kind=leftouter exc on operation_Id
| project timestamp, name, resultCode, duration_ms = round(duration, 1), exception, message, operation_Id
| order by timestamp desc
content.title: Failed requests with their exception (copy operation_Id into Trace lookup)

content.query:
exceptions
| where client_Type != "Browser"
| summarize count = count(), first_seen = min(timestamp), last_seen = max(timestamp), sample_operation_Id = take_any(operation_Id) by type, outerMessage, method
| order by count desc
content.title: Exceptions, most frequent first

content.query:
traces
| where client_Type != "Browser" and severityLevel >= 2
| project timestamp, level = case(severityLevel == 2, "Warning", severityLevel == 3, "Error", "Critical"), message, operation_Id
| order by timestamp desc
content.title: Warning and error logs

content.json: PostgreSQL calls made by the API (the `app` database, through EF Core and Npgsql).

content.query:
dependencies
| where client_Type != "Browser" and type contains "postgres"
| summarize queries = count(), failed = countif(success == false) by bin(timestamp, {TimeRange:grain})
| render timechart
content.title: Queries and failures

content.query:
dependencies
| where client_Type != "Browser" and type contains "postgres"
| summarize p50 = percentile(duration, 50), p95 = percentile(duration, 95), p99 = percentile(duration, 99) by bin(timestamp, {TimeRange:grain})
| render timechart
content.title: Query duration (ms)

content.query:
dependencies
| where client_Type != "Browser" and type contains "postgres"
| extend statement = iff(isempty(data), name, data)
| summarize calls = count(), failed = countif(success == false), avg_ms = round(avg(duration), 2), p95_ms = round(percentile(duration, 95), 2), total_ms = round(sum(duration), 1) by statement
| order by total_ms desc
content.title: Statements, by total time

content.query:
dependencies
| where client_Type != "Browser" and type contains "postgres"
| where success == false
| project timestamp, statement = iff(isempty(data), name, data), resultCode, duration_ms = round(duration, 1), target, operation_Id
| order by timestamp desc
content.title: Failed queries (copy operation_Id into Trace lookup)

content.query:
customMetrics
| where name startswith "db.client.connection"
| summarize value = sum(valueSum) / sum(valueCount) by name, bin(timestamp, {TimeRange:grain})
| render timechart
content.title: Connection pool (Npgsql metrics)

content.query:
customMetrics
| where name startswith "db.client" or name startswith "npgsql"
| summarize average = round(sum(valueSum) / sum(valueCount), 3), samples = sum(valueCount), latest = max(timestamp) by name
| order by name asc
content.title: All database client metrics

content.json: Redis commands sent by the API. The to-do list is cached for 5 minutes and removed on every change, so a `GET /api/todos` that makes no database call was answered from the cache.

content.query:
let withDatabase = dependencies | where client_Type != "Browser" and type contains "postgres" | distinct operation_Id;
requests
| where name in ("GET /api/todos/", "GET /api/todos")
| extend result = iff(operation_Id in (withDatabase), "miss (read the database)", "hit")
| summarize count() by result, bin(timestamp, {TimeRange:grain})
| render timechart
content.title: To-do list requests: cache hits and misses

content.query:
dependencies
| where client_Type != "Browser" and type contains "redis"
| summarize count() by name, bin(timestamp, {TimeRange:grain})
| render timechart
content.title: Commands

content.query:
dependencies
| where client_Type != "Browser" and type contains "redis"
| summarize p50 = percentile(duration, 50), p95 = percentile(duration, 95), p99 = percentile(duration, 99) by bin(timestamp, {TimeRange:grain})
| render timechart
content.title: Command duration (ms)

content.query:
dependencies
| where client_Type != "Browser" and type contains "redis"
| summarize calls = count(), failed = countif(success == false), avg_ms = round(avg(duration), 2), p95_ms = round(percentile(duration, 95), 2) by name, target
| order by calls desc
content.title: By command

content.query:
dependencies
| where client_Type != "Browser" and type contains "redis"
| where success == false
| project timestamp, name, data, resultCode, duration_ms = round(duration, 1), target, operation_Id
| order by timestamp desc
content.title: Failed commands (copy operation_Id into Trace lookup)

content.json: Telemetry the API records itself for the to-do list (`TodoTelemetry.cs`): a span per operation, events inside the spans, and the `todos.*` metrics.

content.query:
customMetrics
| where name == "todos.changes"
| summarize changes = sum(valueSum) by change = tostring(customDimensions.change), bin(timestamp, {TimeRange:grain})
| render timechart
content.title: Changes (todos.changes, counter)

content.query:
customMetrics
| where name == "todos.list.reads"
| summarize reads = sum(valueSum) by result = tostring(customDimensions.result), bin(timestamp, {TimeRange:grain})
| render timechart
content.title: List reads by cache result (todos.list.reads, counter)

content.query:
customMetrics
| where name == "todos.completion.time"
| summarize average = sum(valueSum) / sum(valueCount), longest = max(valueMax) by bin(timestamp, {TimeRange:grain})
| render timechart
content.title: Time to complete an item, seconds (todos.completion.time, histogram)

content.query:
customMetrics
| where name == "todos.items"
| summarize items = sum(valueSum) / sum(valueCount) by state = tostring(customDimensions.state), bin(timestamp, {TimeRange:grain})
| render timechart
content.title: Items in the list (todos.items, gauge)

content.query:
dependencies
| where client_Type != "Browser" and name startswith "todos."
| summarize calls = count(), failed = countif(success == false), avg_ms = round(avg(duration), 2), p95_ms = round(percentile(duration, 95), 2) by name
| order by calls desc
content.title: Operations (custom spans)

content.query:
traces
| where client_Type != "Browser" and (message startswith "todo." or message startswith "cache.")
| project timestamp, event = message, details = tostring(customDimensions), operation_Id
| order by timestamp desc
content.title: Span events (copy operation_Id into Trace lookup)

content.query:
customMetrics
| where name in ("http.server.active_requests")
| summarize value = sum(valueSum) / sum(valueCount) by name, bin(timestamp, {TimeRange:grain})
| render timechart
content.title: Requests in progress

content.query:
customMetrics
| where name in ("dotnet.process.memory.working_set", "dotnet.gc.last_collection.heap.size")
| summarize value = sum(valueSum) / sum(valueCount) by name, bin(timestamp, {TimeRange:grain})
| render timechart
content.title: Memory (bytes)

content.query:
customMetrics
| where name in ("dotnet.thread_pool.thread.count", "dotnet.thread_pool.queue.length")
| summarize value = sum(valueSum) / sum(valueCount) by name, bin(timestamp, {TimeRange:grain})
| render timechart
content.title: Thread pool

content.query:
requests
| summarize instances = dcount(cloud_RoleInstance) by bin(timestamp, {TimeRange:grain})
| render timechart
content.title: Running instances

content.query:
traces
| where message startswith "Application started" or message startswith "Now listening on" or message startswith "Application is shutting down"
| project timestamp, message, cloud_RoleInstance
| order by timestamp desc
content.title: App starts and stops (a start nobody deployed is a crash or a restart)

content.json: Everything recorded for one request, in order: the request, its database and cache calls, logs and exceptions. Paste an `operation_Id` from any table in this workbook.

content.query:
union
(requests | project timestamp, kind = "request", what = name, duration_ms = round(duration, 2), result = resultCode, operation_Id),
(dependencies | project timestamp, kind = strcat("call: ", type), what = iff(isempty(data), name, data), duration_ms = round(duration, 2), result = iff(success == true, "ok", strcat("failed ", resultCode)), operation_Id),
(traces | project timestamp, kind = "log", what = message, duration_ms = real(null), result = case(severityLevel >= 3, "Error", severityLevel == 2, "Warning", ""), operation_Id),
(exceptions | project timestamp, kind = "exception", what = strcat(type, ": ", outerMessage), duration_ms = real(null), result = "", operation_Id)
| where operation_Id == "{OperationId}"
| project-away operation_Id
| order by timestamp asc
content.title: Timeline
